newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.25 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Canada set special purchase and resale agreements at 3.25 percent in the money market after the overnight lending or call loan rate hit the ceiling of the Bank of Canada's target range, traders said.
They said the central bank intervened in the money market to reaffirm its 50 basis point target range of 2.75 percent to 3.25 percent for the overnight lending rate.
Canada's three-month when-issued T-bill yield slid one basis point to 2.95 percent from this morning' open, while the call loan rate rose from around 3.10 percent at the open.
